beliefs: f applies a uniform +2 ASCII shift to every character, including letters, digits, punctuation, space, and high characters [E15, E16, E17, E18, E19]
Lowercase letters shift by +2: a->c, ..., z->| [E15, E17, E18, E19]
Uppercase letters shift by +2: A->C, ..., Z->\ [E17, E18, E19]
Space becomes $ and punctuation shifts by +2 (e.g. !->%, ~->\u0082) [E17, E19]
Characters near DEL shift past it: \u007f->\u0081, \u0080->\u0082 [E17, E19]
No wrapping or clamping occurs at any boundary; the shift is unbounded [E17, E19]
